dialect.detail: JMA ORCA medical receipt software (JMA standard receipt software), developed by NACL. Uses GnuCOBOL/OpenCOBOL conventions with COPY includes (.INC files), fixed format, no EXEC SQL/CICS.

purpose.domain_detail: Japanese medical insurance claim (receipt) processing system - outpatient medical treatment act expansion and registration processing subprogram
purpose.summary: This is a subprogram within the JMA ORCA medical receipt software system that handles outpatient medical treatment act (診療行為) expansion and registration processing. It manages work tables for medical procedure scoring, insurance point calculations, time-based surcharges, and various medical fee calculation rules under Japanese national health insurance. The program has been maintained from 2005 through 2016 with numerous revisions for regulatory changes.

notable_features: Japanese EUC-JP encoded comments (latin-1 decoded as garbled)
No EXEC SQL or EXEC CICS
Extensive revision history in comments spanning 2005-2016
Medical procedure code tables embedded as FILLER VALUE literals
verdict.notes: File is encoded in EUC-JP (Japanese) but decoded as latin-1, causing garbled display of Japanese comments. The program is clearly part of the well-known JMA ORCA open-source medical receipt system used widely in Japanese clinics. Source truncated at 16000 chars out of 220738 bytes total (4950 lines), so only the DATA DIVISION working-storage section is visible; PROCEDURE DIVISION not shown but confirmed present per mechanical indicators.
